question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The socio-economic policy has been the ______ of much debate
solution:
The correct answer is **"Subject"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meanings of the given words-
 
 
• **Subject- **the thing that is being discussed, considered, or studied

 
 
• **Example- **Our subject for discussion is homelessness.
